streaming.title: Streaming
streaming.engineSubtitle: xg2g manages video bitrate, resolution, and codecs adaptively based on your connection. No manual profile selection required.
streaming.cardEngineText: Automatically detects hardware acceleration (GPU: VAAPI, NVENC, QSV, VideoToolbox) on the server and falls back seamlessly to optimized CPU encoding. Dynamically scales bitrate and resolution (720p minimum up to native 1080p).
streaming.cardCodecsText: Dynamic negotiation of the best codecs: AV1 & HEVC (H.265) for maximum quality at minimum bandwidth, H.264 for universal compatibility, and MPEG-2 for lossless direct play on LAN.
streaming.cardContainersText: Modern low-latency HLS (fMP4 / CMAF) for rapid channel switching on HD channels, plus legacy MPEG-TS for full receiver compatibility.
streaming.cardInterlacedText: Progressive channels (720p, 1080p) pass through untouched. Interlaced broadcasts (e.g. 1080i / 576i) are automatically deinterlaced to smooth 50 fps progressive video without comb artifacts.
